    Title: General rule
    Definition: Each platform on all working levels of scaffolds shall be fully planked or decked between the front uprights and the guardrail supports
    Source: 1926.451(b)(1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: General rule
    Definition: Guardrail systems shall be installed along all open sides and ends of platforms.
    Source: 1926.451(g)(4)
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: General rule
    Definition: The top edge height of toprails or equivalent member on supported scaffolds shall be installed between 38 inches (0.97 m) and 45 inches (1.2 m) above the platform surface.
    Source: 1926.451(g)(4)(ii)

    Title: General rule
    Definition: In addition to wearing hardhats each employee on a scaffold shall be provided with additional protection from falling hand tools, debris, and other small objects through the installation of toeboards, screens, or guardrail systems, or through the erection of debris nets, catch platforms, or canopy structures that contain or deflect the falling objects.
